title: Minimize Deviation in Array
description: Minimize the deviation of an array by doubling odd numbers and halving even numbers.
pseudocode:
1: Push all odd nums * 2 and all even nums into MaxHeap
2: minVal = min of all initial values
3: deviation = maxHeap.top - minVal
4: while maxHeap.top is even:
5:   val = maxHeap.pop / 2
6:   maxHeap.push(val)
7:   minVal = min(minVal, val)
8:   deviation = min(deviation, maxHeap.top - minVal)

steps.note: Initialize heap with [4, 2] (odd 1 becomes 2, 2 stays 2). minVal = 2
